info.title: Hanzo Cloud API
info.description: Generated from the live router — every operation below is a route the unified cloud binary actually serves. Tagged by product: the first path segment after /v1/.

get.summary: list returns the public starter-kit catalog plus, for a validated caller, that org's own templates.
get.description:
list returns the public starter-kit catalog plus, for a validated caller, that org's own templates.
No request field can widen the scope: the org comes from the gateway-minted,
JWT-validated principal, so an anonymous or cross-org caller structurally sees
the public catalog only.

post.summary: publish creates a template private to the caller's org and answers 201.
post.description:
publish creates a template private to the caller's org and answers 201.
The slug must be free in both layers — publishing over a public-catalog slug is
409 — and the owner, tier and rating are stamped by the server, never by the body.

delete.summary: remove deletes the caller org's own template and answers 204.
delete.description:
remove deletes the caller org's own template and answers 204.
A slug they do not own is a 404, never a delete: the DELETE binds org.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Slug is the template's id, lowercase alphanumeric with dashes.

get.summary: get returns one template: the caller org's own if they have that slug, else the public one.
get.description:
get returns one template: the caller org's own if they have that slug, else the public one.
An unknown slug is a 404; an anonymous caller resolves against the public catalog only.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Slug is the template's id, lowercase alphanumeric with dashes.

put.summary: replace overwrites the caller org's own template at :slug, keeping the path's identity.
put.description:
replace overwrites the caller org's own template at :slug, keeping the path's identity.
A slug the caller does not own is a 404 — the UPDATE binds org, so a PUT can
never reach another org's row — and the body cannot rename the template.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description:
Slug is the template's id: lowercase alphanumeric with dashes, max 40. On a
replace the path owns it and a body slug is ignored.

category.description: Category groups the entry in the gallery browser.

description.description: Description is the gallery blurb, max 4096 characters.

features.description: Features are the selling-point bullets, max 32.

framework.description: Framework is the stack the kit is built on ("next", "astro", …).

org.description: owner of a PRIVATE template; empty in the public catalog

preview.description: Preview is the screenshot or preview URL, max 4096 characters.

rating.description: Rating is a public-gallery curation score; server-owned, ignored on a write.

slug.description:
Slug is the template's id: lowercase alphanumeric with dashes, max 40. On a
replace the path owns it and a body slug is ignored.

source.description: Source is the repository the fork clones from, max 4096 characters.

tier.description: Tier is a public-gallery curation rank; server-owned, ignored on a write.

title.description: Title is the display name; required, max 200 characters.

useCase.description: UseCase is what the kit is for, in one phrase.

variants.description: the shapes this template ships in

data.description: Data is the templates, public entries first.

framework.description: only when it differs from the template's

kind.description: the axis it varies: format | page | theme
